name: AI Sales Chat Agent by AnroAgents
author: anrotech

sections.description:
AnroAgents Chat lets you embed an AI-powered chat agent on your WordPress website with just two settings: your Agent ID and API Key.

Your AI agent can answer questions, help customers, generate leads, and provide 24/7 support — all without writing a single line of code.

Features

  • One-click setup — install the plugin, enter your credentials, done
  • AI-powered conversations — your agent understands context and provides intelligent responses
  • Customizable appearance — match the chat widget to your site’s branding (colors, position, greeting message)
  • File attachments — visitors can share files with your agent (PDF, DOCX, CSV, and more)
  • Mobile-friendly — responsive design that works on all devices
  • Lightweight — the widget is only ~32 KB and loads asynchronously, so it won’t slow down your site
  • Free tier available — get started at no cost

How It Works

  1. Sign up at AnroAgents (free tier available)
  2. Create an AI agent and configure its knowledge base
  3. Install this plugin and enter your Agent ID and API Key
  4. The chat widget appears on your site — your AI agent is live!

Use Cases

  • Customer support — answer FAQs automatically, 24/7
  • Lead generation — engage visitors and collect contact information
  • E-commerce assistance — help shoppers find products and answer questions
  • Knowledge base — let visitors search your documentation through natural conversation
  • Appointment booking — guide visitors through scheduling
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ai-sales-chat-agent-by-anroagents folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings → AnroAgents Chat
  4. Enter your Agent ID and API Key from your AnroAgents dashboard
  5. Save changes — the chat widget is now live on your site!
sections.faq:
Do I need an AnroAgents account?

Yes. You need a free account at anroagents.com to create an AI agent and get your credentials.

Is there a free plan?

Yes! AnroAgents offers a free tier so you can get started without any payment.

Will the widget slow down my site?

No. The widget script (~32 KB) loads asynchronously and does not block page rendering.

Can I customize the widget’s appearance?

Yes. You can change the accent color, position (bottom-right or bottom-left), greeting message, and chat title from the plugin settings.

Does it work with caching plugins?

Yes. The widget loads via an external script tag and is fully compatible with all WordPress caching plugins.

Where is my data stored?

Conversations are processed through AnroAgents’ secure cloud infrastructure. See the AnroAgents Privacy Policy for details.
